key_insight: Muon can substantially improve agentic RL post-training, but only under the right optimizer, advantage estimator, and learning-rate setting.
engineering_relevance: For sparse-reward RL agents, optimizer choice is not a minor detail: Muon may yield large gains over AdamW when applied to hidden matrices in the right training regime.
method: Matched single-seed comparisons on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
Compared vanilla Muon vs AdamW under GiGPO, GRPO, and GraphGPO
Applied Muon only to hidden weight matrices and varied learning rate
evidence_signal: In the abstract’s ALFWorld evaluations, Muon raised GiGPO final-window validation success from 0.290 to 0.546, improved GRPO from 0.161 to 0.268 at 3e-5, and reached 0.901 validation success with GraphGPO at 1e-5.
watch_item: The results are exploratory single-seed findings, so multi-seed and cross-task validation are still needed before drawing general conclusions.
paper_title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
